target.output: portfolio dedupe-key exclusive claim fence plus durable loser boundary
target.scope: same portfolio dedupe_key across concurrent fresh /wc workers

canonical_identity.problem: Portfolio workers create claims at coordination/portfolio/claims/<job_id>/<unique claim_id>.json. Because every contender writes a different path, create-if-absent never arbitrates the dedupe_key. Live canary evidence produced multiple active claims for the same Alumnos job within seconds; at least one later worker entered substantive archaeology before observing the earlier claimant.
acceptance: For one live portfolio dedupe_key, at most one worker obtains substantive execution authority during a claim lease generation.
Atomic create-if-absent/CAS or an equivalent deterministic election uses a shared fence identity, not each contender's unique claim_id path.
Losing contenders persist append-only collision/boundary evidence and immediately re-enter allocation without substantive target writes.
Historical claim evidence remains immutable and late returns remain reconcilable.
A concurrent fresh-/wc fixture or live canary demonstrates exactly one substantive winner for the same portfolio dedupe_key.

dedup_note: Distinct from the existing normal claim-attempt receipt proposal and recovery-generation race proposal. This gap is specific to the newly introduced portfolio fallback contract: unique per-claim file paths cannot provide create-if-absent exclusivity for a shared dedupe_key.
